description: This file defines the UsernamePasswordAuthenticationScheme class, which implements a username-password based authentication scheme for the OpenMRS system. It extends DaoAuthenticationScheme and provides an authenticate method that verifies credentials and returns an authenticated user if successful.

classes.name: UsernamePasswordAuthenticationScheme
classes.description: A class implementing a username-password based authentication scheme for OpenMRS, extending DaoAuthenticationScheme, primarily used for authenticating users with credentials.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates the provided credentials by verifying they are of type UsernamePasswordCredentials and then using the context DAO to authenticate the username and password. Throws ContextAuthenticationException if credentials are invalid or of incorrect type.
